question: 2025학년도 1학기 EE211-02(확률및랜덤변수)와 2025학년도 1학기 CSE438-00(최신기술콜로키움1)의 중간·기말 비율 합계를 각각 구하고, 두 번째 합계에서 첫 번째 합계를 뺀 차이도 알려줘.
pred_sql:
WITH first_course AS (
    SELECT s.midterm_percentage + s.final_exam_percentage AS exam_sum
    FROM course_offerings co
    JOIN syllabi s ON s.offering_id = co.offering_id
    WHERE co.year = 2025 AND co.semester = '1'
      AND co.course_code = 'EE211' AND co.section = '02'
),
second_course AS (
    SELECT s.midterm_percentage + s.final_exam_percentage AS exam_sum
    FROM course_offerings co
    JOIN syllabi s ON s.offering_id = co.offering_id
    WHERE co.year = 2025 AND co.semester = '1'
      AND co.course_code = 'CSE438' AND co.section = '00'
)
SELECT
    f.exam_sum AS first_exam_sum,
    s.exam_sum AS second_exam_sum,
    s.exam_sum - f.exam_sum AS difference
FROM first_course f
CROSS JOIN second_course s;

question: 2026학년도 2학기 EE209-02(논리회로)와 2026학년도 1학기 CSE204-01(자료구조) 중 중간고사 비율이 더 큰 강좌의 과목코드·연도·학기·분반·비율을 알려줘. 같으면 둘 다 알려줘.
pred_sql:
WITH target AS (
    SELECT
        co.course_code,
        co.year,
        co.semester,
        co.section,
        s.midterm_percentage
    FROM course_offerings AS co
    JOIN syllabi AS s ON s.offering_id = co.offering_id
    WHERE (co.year = 2026 AND co.semester = '2' AND co.course_code = 'EE209' AND co.section = '02')
       OR (co.year = 2026 AND co.semester = '1' AND co.course_code = 'CSE204' AND co.section = '01')
)
SELECT
    course_code,
    year,
    semester,
    section,
    midterm_percentage
FROM target
WHERE midterm_percentage = (SELECT MAX(midterm_percentage) FROM target)
ORDER BY year, semester, course_code, section;
